svg.data-weight-note: 23 lb (10.43 kg) with two power supplies (Table 24)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.48 in (52.02 cm) excluding fan and power supply handles (Table 24)
svg.data-switching-capacity: 960 Gbps aggregate throughput (guide, QFX5110-48S Hardware); see the throughput gap
svg.data-latency: 550 ns (guide, Benefits of QFX5110, for the line)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE with SFP+ optics; 1 GbE with SFP optics; 100 Mbps from Junos OS 18.3R1
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 GbE or 40 GbE; or four 10 GbE with a 40 GbE breakout cable
svg.data-power-input-ac: 90 to 264 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 3.6 A at 90 VAC (guide Table 14)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -39 to -60 VDC, operating range -40 to -72 VDC, -8.2 A at 39 VDC (guide Table 19)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; one may be removed and replaced while the switch runs
svg.data-fans: five fan modules, hot-swappable; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing; 5 to 93 percent short term
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 2000 m (6562 ft)
svg.data-timing: RJ-45 grandmaster clock port (GM), 10 MHz output, 1 PPS output
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches in a ring with QFX5110 or QFX5100 members; also a Virtual Chassis Fabric leaf
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+, 1 GbE SFP, SFP+ direct attach cable and active optical cable
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE QSFP28 and 40 GbE QSFP+, direct attach and active optical cables, breakout cables to SFP+
svg.data-oob: management port C0 (RJ-45, em0, with a second C0 SFP cage) and C1 (SFP, em1)
svg.data-usb: one USB port for image updates
